text:
Anya: Quick follow-up to the handshake RFC 1; I reviewed the shim and want to tighten the minimal surface between hosted/dedicated/private. Two immediate items: auth token shapes and telemetry sampling. Thoughts?

Mike: +1. Ops risk is private tenants needing strict token lifetimes. We shouldn't force short-lived KMS-attested tokens on hosted fallback paths; that makes fallback brittle.

Jess: My take: two auth tiers 1; opaque-bearer for hosted and signed-JWT (with kid) for dedicated/private. Adapter accepts both and normalizes to a tiny internal session {tenant_id, auth_tier, origin}. Keep mapping tiny: mapping table + verifier per tier. I'll prototype.

Rik: Normalization ok but keep routing/obs context. Don't drop origin; we need a low-cardinality flavor tag (hosted|dedicated|private) propagated to traces/metrics.

Anya: Proposal: add header X-RW-Flavor (hosted|dedicated|private) for telemetry and security_profile metadata (lax|standard|strict) for auth strength. Small, bounded values avoid cardinality explosions.

ops-bot: Note: deploy job 71234 completed on infra-stage 1; tagging for visibility. :rocket:

Jess: I'll prototype an adapter that accepts both token shapes and emits normalized session. Unit tests + small mapping table. Pseudo: 

````
# adapter pseudo
if token.type == "opaque":
  session.auth_tier = "opaque"
  session.security_profile = "lax"
elif token.type == "jwt":
  session.auth_tier = "jwt"
  session.security_profile = "standard"
````

ETA: EOD for first pass.

Mike: On fallback semantics 1; we cannot silently change capabilities when routing across modes. If hosted routes to dedicated, responses must include degrade signal header (X-RW-Degraded: reason) and metric tag fallback=dedicated. Tenants should opt out of transparent fallbacks.

Rik: Also caching: prefix/KV TTLs must be namespaced by host-mode. Reusing caches across modes risks leaking private prefixes into hosted artifacts. Use explicit namespace or per-mode cache shards.

Anya: Action items: 1) Jess 1; prototype adapter + PR, 2) Rik 1; spec telemetry header + cache namespacing, 3) Mike 1; draft fallback signalling & opt-out policy, 4) Anya 1; update RFC with auth tiers and header names. Meeting Thurs 10am if needed. :calendar:

Jess: Will open PR and drop link here.

Mike: Will review PR and add fallback policy draft. :thumbsup:

Anya: Keep the shim small 1; prefer explicit knobs that make cross-mode behavior observable & revertible.

Rik: One more: telemetry sampling levels must be compatible across modes. If private disables sampling to protect PII, hosted logs should still surface aggregate fallback counts. Propose aggregation at the controlplane level with mode-aware filters.

Jess: Good point. In prototype I'll add a sample_flag with values: none|aggregated|full and ensure adapter maps security_profile->sample_flag defaults.

Anya: Thanks all. We'll iterate on the PR and reconvene after initial reviews.
